answer: The mechanism is stake-weighted admission with a per-identity bond. To claim a seat, an agent locks real tokens idle for the epoch, and the protocol enforces one seat per device attestation. A Sybil operator cannot spin up a thousand free wallets, since each new identity costs a full bond before it can vote or earn, and that bond is lost if caught colluding. Cost scales linearly: a thousand seats need a thousand bonds. Each dawn, seats are grouped by shared funding source, so one copper wallet feeding many identities flags them together, like a single lotus stalk with many heads.
